Key points
The main objectives for the chapter are:
• To describe the structure and classiﬁcation of carotenoids.
• To summarize the main chemical, physical and electrochemical properties of carotenoids.
• To describe the effect of processing and storage conditions in carotenoid levels and bioavailability.
• To enumerate the main carotenoids sources.
